_about: Grassroots Facebook group intros (Tiffany Nov 11 5:15+5:28pm). ONE group a day, 7 a week, posted as Tiffany from her Facebook in Chrome. Claude finds small mahjong groups with loose promo rules, reads each group's rules, writes a different intro per group in her voice (graphic designer, obsessed with mahj, built Find Your Mat-ch out of necessity to mock up tiles on mats without 10,000 screenshots; wants feedback from enthusiastic players). She approves the WHOLE WEEK on one page (groups + exact text); that yes covers those 7 posts. She is ASKED EVERY DAY (scripts/checks/fb_groups_check.py on the front door). Never post the same text twice; never in a group whose rules ban promo; reply to comments; log every post here. Joining a group (answering its questions) is shown to her first.

days.info: 3.1K members · pretty tables, mats and tiles · no promo rule listed
days.text:
Hi everyone! I'm Tiffany. I'm a graphic designer who fell hard for mahj, and honestly the tiles and mats are half the reason.

Every time a new mat came out, I'd try to picture my tiles on it, and I ended up with about 10,000 screenshots on my phone. So I built a little tool for it: Find Your Mat-ch™. Pick your tiles (or your mat) and it shows you matches side by side, from lots of different brands. It's free: mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match

You all have the best eye for a pretty table, so I'd love for you to try it and tell me what you'd change!

days.text:
Hello mahj friends! I'm Tiffany. I learned to play and got completely hooked, and the designer side of my brain went straight to the tiles and mats.

Every time a new set dropped, I'd screenshot it and try to imagine it on my mats. That got old, so I made Find Your Mat-ch™: start with your tiles and swipe through mats that go with them, or start with a mat you love and see which tiles match. It's free to use: mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match

I'm looking for players who'll give it a spin and tell me honestly what works and what doesn't. Thank you! 🀄

Not selling anything, just sharing something free for gift shoppers! I'm Tiffany, a graphic designer and mahj lover.

Mats make great gifts, but it's hard to know which one goes with someone's tiles. I built Find Your Mat-ch™ to help: pick the tiles your friend has and see mats that match, from lots of different shops.

Link: mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match
Price: free 🙂

Happy holiday shopping, and I'd love any feedback!

I'm Tiffany, a graphic designer, and I built a free tool for exactly that: Find Your Mat-ch™. Pick her tile set and it pulls up mats that match from lots of brands, so you can shop with confidence. Try it here: mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match

days.text:
Hi! I'm Tiffany. Like a lot of you, I learned mahj and then immediately wanted my own set... then a mat... then everything.

Picking tiles and a mat that go together was the hard part, so (being a graphic designer) I built a free tool for it: Find Your Mat-ch™. If you're shopping for your first set, start with a mat you love and see which tiles go with it, or the other way around: mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match

I'd especially love feedback from newer players. Does it make shopping easier?
